010107:
- About capacitors in this player

This player achieves high quality sound through the use of newly developed polymer capacitors and OS-CON and POSCAP capacitors in the player's amplifier circuit. The electrical characteristics of these capacitors become stable after about 200 hours of use, reaching the point where they produce the highest quality sound.

To properly age the capacitors to produce the best sound, simply plug in headphones and play music normally. The music selection and volume settings do not matter in the aging process.

Note: "OS-CON" and "POSCAP" are registered trademarks of Panasonic Corporation.
010109:
- About the equalizer and tone control on this player

You can adjust the sound to suit your preferences by selecting the equalizer or tone control and adjusting the acoustic characteristics of the player.

The equalizer enables you to make fine adjustment to the sound with the total frequency range divided into 10 segments that you can control individually. The tone control similarly enables easy adjustment of three frequency ranges: low, middle and high. You can switch between the equalizer and tone control at will, because their settings are saved separately.

You cannot, however, use them both at the same time.

- About capacitors in this player

This player achieves high quality sound through the use of newly developed polymer capacitors and POSCAP capacitors in the player's amplifier circuit. The electrical characteristics of these capacitors become stable after about 200 hours of use, reaching the point where they produce the highest quality sound.

Aging of the capacitors occurs while playing back typical songs at normal volumes with headphones connected to the player. Aging does not occur, however, while playing back at minimum volumes. Full aging requires about 200 hours use of each headphone jack (stereo mini and balanced standard).

Note: "POSCAP" is a registered trademark of Panasonic Corporation.

010169:
- About capacitors in this player

This player achieves high quality sound through the use of newly developed polymer capacitors and POSCAP capacitors in the player's amplifier circuit. The electrical characteristics of these capacitors gradually become stable after about 200 hours of aging, reaching the point where they produce the highest quality sound.

Aging of the capacitors occurs while playing back songs you usually listen to or sample songs with headphones connected to the player. Aging does not occur, however, while playing back with muting enabled, so, in order to age the capacitors, play music at least at minimum volume. Audio volume and audio settings do not affect the aging process. Aging on this player occurs using either headphone jack outputs (stereo mini and balanced standard).

Note: "POSCAP" is a registered trademark of Panasonic Corporation.

- About power source switch

You can switch between AC power and battery power even when the AC adaptor is connected. Battery power offers a cleaner power signal, providing higher audio quality.

You can switch power sources in the window displayed by tapping the status bar. You can also set this player to default start to prefer battery power when available by selecting the option in Settings.
